declaration.preface: At Aegistek Corporation Ltd., we are committed to uphold principles of labor & human rights and foster a culture of respect and transparency. We recognize the dignity and worth of every individual, and we are dedicated to providing a safe and fair working environment for all employees. Our policy prioritizes the protection of workers' rights, including the right to fair wages, equal opportunities and freedom from discrimination or harassment.
declaration.declaration:
Ethical Responsibility: Ensure ethical business practices and recognizing importance of respecting the rights and dignity of all individuals associated with our company.

Employee Welfare: Prioritizing the well-being and safety of employees by establishing standards for fair wages, safe working conditions, and equal opportunities, fostering a positive workplace culture.

Compliance: This includes adherence to labor laws, safety regulations and human rights standards set by the International Labor Organization (ILO) and the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR).

Risk Mitigation: Committed to mitigate the risks associated with labor-related issues such as employee turnover, absenteeism, and labor unrest, thereby safeguarding business continuity and stability.
declaration.scope: This Labor & Human Rights Policy applies to the operation of Aegistek Corporation Ltd., covering all Employees, Stakeholders, Contractors and individual affiliated with Aegistek.

Workforce Health and Safety: Ensuring full regulatory compliance to limit exposure to occupational hazards and providing comprehensive safety training to all employees.
Working Condition: Our key targets include limiting the maximum weekly working hours to 48 hours and ensuring that employees receive a minimum of two days off per week.
We aim to limit overtime hours to a maximum of 36 hours per week to prevent employee burnout and ensure overtime wages at 1.5 times the regular pay rate by 2025 from the baseline year 2023.
Labor Relations: By 2025, achieve a 15% increase in the establishment of regular forums for open communication and collaboration between management and employees, fostering a culture of mutual respect and understanding to facilitate structured social dialogue.
Professional Growth: To ensure fair compensation practices, the policy sets a target of achieving a salary equity index of 95% or above and targeting a 90% increase in average training hours by 2025 from the baseline year of 2023 for their personal and professional growth.
Targeting 65% increase in average participation in career development programs by 2025 from the baseline year of 2023 for their career advancement and skill development.
Child and Forced Labor: By 2025, our goal is to achieve zero tolerance for instances of child and forced labor throughout our supply chain.

We are committed to ensure that 60% of suppliers adhere to international labor standards and increasing awareness among 100% employees of basic labor rights and enhance transparency in reporting any unfair labor practices.
Diversity, Equality and Integration: We are committed to achieve 100% pay equity among employees performing similar roles, irrespective of gender and rectify any existing disparities within six months of implementing the policy.
Third-party human rights: By 2025, we pledge to conduct regular audits and assessments of our external stakeholders, including suppliers and partners, to ensure alignment with internationally recognized human rights standards, such as the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.
By 2025, we will ensure that 100% of employees and associated stakeholders receive training on labor risks and prevention.

responsibilities.duty: The executive team sets the tone and allocates necessary resources for implementing initiatives aligned with this policy.
HR manager is responsible for policy implementation and oversight, developing guidelines, procedures, and comprehensive training programs.
All employees actively uphold policy principles, promptly report violations, and contribute to a respectful workplace culture.
The Compliance team diligently monitors effectiveness, compiles relevant data, and transparently communicates outcomes.
The CSR team actively fosters partnerships to promote best practices and facilitate collective action.
Departments regularly review practices to ensure alignment with evolving standards and identify areas for enhancement.
Legal and Compliance diligently ensures adherence to relevant laws, regulations, and international standards.

policy.monitoring:
Reporting mechanisms are essential for monitoring and evaluating the effectiveness of the Labor & Human Rights Policy at Aegistek Corporation Ltd. The company is committed to fostering a culture of transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement through regular reporting on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to labor and human rights.

Internal Reporting: Aegistek encourages all employees to report any violations or concerns related to labor and human rights to HR department. Reports will be treated confidentially, and non-retaliation policies are in place to protect whistleblowers.

Compliance Audits: The company conducts regular audits and assessments to ensure compliance with the Labor & Human Rights Policy, as well as relevant laws and regulations. These audits may include on-site inspections, document reviews, and interviews with employees and stakeholders. Findings are documented, and corrective actions are implemented as needed.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Aegistek monitors and reports on various KPIs to track progress toward achieving the objectives outlined in the policy. KPIs may include metrics related to workplace safety incidents, employee turnover rates, diversity and inclusion initiatives, labor relations, and supplier compliance with ethical standards.

Stakeholder Engagement: Aegistek actively engages with stakeholders, including employees, suppliers, customers, and local communities, to gather feedback and input on labor and human rights issues. Stakeholder consultations, surveys, and feedback mechanisms are utilized to assess the effectiveness of the policy and identify areas for improvement.

External Reporting: Aegistek is committed to transparency and accountability in its labor and human rights practices and regularly communicates its progress and challenges through external reporting mechanisms. This may include publishing annual sustainability reports, participating in industry benchmarking initiatives, and disclosing relevant information to investors, customers, and other stakeholders.
policy.reviewMechanism: This policy undergoes annual review by the HR Manager and subsequent approval by the General Manager. Any modifications are promptly communicated to all employees for awareness and compliance.
